product.description: A package name already in the product's group, as the build-suffix-stripped name match/group.ts keys on (e.g. "firefox").

track.description: The track these packages are, e.g. "esr" — see docs/product-families.md.

names.description: Build-suffix-stripped package names that are this track of the product, on any source (e.g. "firefox-esr" also covers "firefox-esr-bin").

reason.description: Why these packages are a parallel line of the product — auditable later.

title: Match: product tracks
description: Parallel lines of a product (Firefox ESR, LibreOffice Still, ...) — merges every listed package into the product's group and labels it with the track. See docs/product-families.md.
